title: AGCP HTTP Interface v2
public_error_contract: {"capacity_unavailable": "503 CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE", "governance_quota_denial": "authoritative Governance Outcome, not HTTP 429", "pre_governance_throttling": "429 REQUEST_THROTTLED with Retry-After delay-seconds", "public_not_found": "404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND"}
metadata_contract: {"active_governance_version_required": true, "baseline_digest_required": true, "ias_profile_bindings_advertised_when_applicable": true, "optional_public_safe_deployment_binding": true, "pep_profile_bindings_advertised_when_applicable": true, "profile_digest_required": true, "schema": "schemas/meta_response.json", "schema_and_validator_digests_required": true}
notes: IF-001 invokes Governance Realization through /commit-boundary/commit. The GRF independently establishes current commit eligibility, selects/applies the PEP Profile, constructs Enforcement Context, and mediates the PEP. Commit Successful is distinct from later asynchronous execution completion. Approval ingress uses server-side IAS qualification; no public IAS or PEP interface is standardized.

title: AGCP Policy Evaluation Contract
notes: GDF/PDP deterministic evaluation contract. It may consume DS-053 qualified identity/authorization input but does not perform Governance Realization or PEP enforcement.

title: AGCP Governance Observation Interface v1
notes: Read-only observations distinguish IAS qualification, GDF/PDP, GRF, PEP enforcement, commitment, and post-commit execution outcome.

title: AGCP Governance Management and Actuation Interface v1
notes: Supporting production management surface. Request acceptance is distinct from authoritative realization; status readback is provided and EFFECTIVE requires ordinary authoritative governance mechanisms, evidence, and observation.

title: AGCP Conformance Test Control Interface v1
notes: Optional isolated test-only surface. Controls establish inputs/dependencies only. TARGET_EXECUTION_FIXTURE supports conditional post-commit asynchronous target testing; ENFORCEMENT_PATH_FAULT_FIXTURE supports controlled enforcement-boundary negative paths after ordinary producing stages. Controls cannot inject governance decisions, execution authorizations, GRF commit results, DS-052 outcomes, or conformance results.
